d: Deep-space escape probes, future stellar flyby targets, interstellar mission concepts, and historical SETI transmissions.

gaia-1129149723913123456.x: Voyager 1 crossed the heliopause in 2012 and will pass within 1.6 light-years of the M-dwarf Gliese 445 (AC +79 3888) in ~40,000 years.

gaia-1926461164913660160.x: Voyager 2 will pass within 1.7 light-years of the red dwarf Ross 248 (Gliese 905) in ~42,000 years before continuing toward a 4.3-ly encounter with Sirius in ~296,000 years.

hip-21421.x: First spacecraft to traverse the Asteroid Belt and visit Jupiter (1973); heading on a hyperbolic trajectory toward the red giant Aldebaran (~2 million years travel time).

overlay-interstellar-missions:pioneer-11.x: First spacecraft to encounter Saturn (1979); escaping the Solar System toward the constellation Scutum and Aquila.

overlay-interstellar-missions:new-horizo.x: Fifth spacecraft to achieve solar escape velocity after conducting the first reconnaissance of Pluto (2015) and Kuiper Belt contact binary 486958 Arrokoth (2019).
overlay-interstellar-missions:new-horizo.u: New Horizons (Pluto & Arrokoth Kuiper Belt Probe)

overlay-interstellar-missions:jwst.x: Premier infrared space observatory orbiting the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point, characterizing exoplanet atmospheres (TRAPPIST-1, K2-18 b, WASP-39 b, LHS 475 b).
overlay-interstellar-missions:jwst.u: James Webb Space Telescope (JWST at Sun-Earth L2)

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Pioneering 1960 SETI radio experiment conducted by Frank Drake at Green Bank Observatory, scanning Tau Ceti and Epsilon Eridani near the 1.420 GHz hydrogen line.
gaia-2452378776434477184.u: Project Ozma (First SETI Survey — Tau Ceti & Epsilon Eridani)

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Target of Breakthrough Starshot (relativistically laser-pushed gram-scale nanocraft at 0.2c reaching Alpha Centauri & Proxima Centauri b in ~20 years) and the 1988 USNA/NASA Project Longshot nuclear-pulse study.

gaia-4472832130942575872.x: Landmark 1973–1978 British Interplanetary Society engineering design for a two-stage inertial-confinement fusion probe accelerating to 0.12c to reach Barnard's Star in 50 years.
gaia-4472832130942575872.u: Project Daedalus (Barnard's Star Fusion Probe Study)

m13-hercules.x: 1,679-bit pictorial radio broadcast transmitted by Frank Drake and Carl Sagan from the Arecibo Observatory on 16 November 1974 toward globular cluster Messier 13.
m13-hercules.u: Arecibo Message Target (Messier 13 / Great Hercules Cluster)

hip-95477.x: Strong narrowband 1420 MHz radio signal recorded by Jerry R. Ehman at the Big Ear radio telescope on 15 August 1977 in Sagittarius near the Chi Sagittarii star group.

b.s: Scientific and historical overlay mapping humanity’s five solar-escape probes (Voyager 1 & 2, Pioneer 10 & 11, New Horizons), JWST, interstellar propulsion studies (Breakthrough Starshot, Project Daedalus, Project Longshot), and landmark SETI broadcasts (Project Ozma, Arecibo Message, Wow! Signal).
b.a: NASA / JPL / SETI Institute / British Interplanetary Society
b.r: NASA JPL Horizons & Bailer-Jones et al. (2019) Gaia DR2 Stellar Encounters
